title: Share a project via a public link
description: Ergonomics probe for project-sharing discoverability: a project needs to exist and get a link share, exercising the create-share composite (src/tools/projects/sharing.ts). RE-VERIFIED 2026-07-25 (netadvanced/vikunja-mcp#28 C1): optimalCallCount reasoning at the time -- create-project (1) + create-task (1, the single "kickoff" task) + create-share (1) = 3. RE-BASELINED 2026-09-02 (issue #202): the CREATION half of that estimate is now stale -- `setup-kanban`'s columns-less form (`title` + `tasks`, no `columns`; issue #185) creates the project and its single kickoff task in ONE call, with zero Kanban structure fabricated. `create-share` is still a distinct, unavoidable second call: it has no columns-less or any-other one-call fold-in with project/task creation (src/tools/projects/sharing.ts has no such composite). New optimum: setup-kanban columns-less (1) + create-share (1) = 2.
promptTemplate: Create a project called "{{prefix}}Shared Roadmap" with one task called "{{prefix}}kickoff", then share the project via a read-only public link so it can be sent to a client.
